{{#setmainimage:Map-Event.png|quiet}} {{Sequel Disambiguation}} {{Ambox | color = var(--highlight-color-watcher) | icon = EventClear.png | message = ''This is information about '''Events''' in Slay the Spire. A full searchable list can be found at [[Events List]].'' }} [[Category:ToUpdate]] Events are unique encounters that present the player with a scenario and asks them to make a choice on how they wish to handle that scenario. These scenarios can involve running into various denizens of the Spire (both [[We Meet Again!|helpful]] and [[Masked Bandits|harmful]]), [[Golden Idol (Event)|triggering traps]], finding [[Upgrade Shrine|shrines]] and [[Forgotten Altar|altars]], [[Sensory Stone|wandering into something strange]], and much more. Events are only encountered in [[Map Locations#Unknown|Unknown floors]]. Each Act has a set of events that can only occur in that Act, but there are also events which can occur in two or three Acts. No events can occur in [[Acts#Act 4: The Ending|Act 4]] as there are no [[Map Locations#Unknown|unknown floors]] to travel to. Starting from {{Asc|15|Ascension}}, some events have less positive outcomes and/or more severe consequences. For example: more HP lost, less gold rewarded, higher prices, or a higher likelihood of being {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Cursed}}. == Encountering Events == Events are not the only type of room that can be encountered in [[Map Locations#Unknown|unknown floors]]. Whenever the player enters an unknown floor, there is a high chance that they will encounter an [[Event]] and a set of much lower chances that they encounter a [[Monsters|Monster]], [[Shop]], or [[Map Locations#Treasure Room|Treasure Room]]. Each room type has a different chance of being encountered, which the game determines randomly when entering the unknown floor. Many events have a set of criteria that must be met in order for them to be encountered. All of an event's criteria must be met for it to be eligible. Some example criteria are: * Being in a specific Act (e.g. {{E|Golden Idol}} is exclusive to Act 1) * Being under or above a specific floor (e.g. {{E|Hypnotizing Colored Mushrooms}} can only be encountered within Act 1 on floor 7 or above) * Having enough [[Gold]] to afford at least one of the event's options (e.g. {{E|The Cleric}} requires at least 35 [[Gold]]) * Having a specific amount of HP remaining (e.g. {{E|Knowing Skull}} requires at least 13 HP, while {{E|The Moai Head}} requires HP to be at or below 50%) * ... and many more. Some events have very unique and specific criteria (e.g. {{E|N'loth}} requires at least 2 [[Relics]], and {{E|The Divine Fountain}} requires a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}) If the game determines that an unknown floor should be an event, there is a high chance that it will be an [[#Act Event|Act Event]] and a lower chance that it will be one of the much rarer [[#Shrine Events|Shrine Events]]. If the event should be one of the rarer [[#Shrine Events|Shrine Events]], the game will combine the eligible [[#Shrines|Shrine]] and [[#One-Time Event|One-Time Event]] pools and then pick a random event from that combined pool. == Types of Events == While there is no in-game distinction between event types, it can be useful to understand the internal details because different event types have different rules on how they can be encountered. Internally, there are 3 types of events: [[#Act Events|Act Events]], [[#Shrines|Shrines]], and [[#One-Time Events|One-Time Events]]. ''Note:'' There is an "unofficial" event type which the Slay the Spire community calls [[#Shrine Events|"Shrine Events"]]. This is different from (but related to) [[#Shrines|Shrines]]. The language used on this page is '''''very careful''''' to correctly refer to "Shrines" or "Shrine Events" depending on the context, as these are two separate terms that '''do not mean the same thing''' but are closely related and easy to mix up. Read those sections for more information. See the table below for a quick summary of the differences between event types. {| class="wikitable" |+Event Type Summary !Event Type !Encounter Frequency !Restricted to a
Specific Act? !Repeatable? !Sometimes Referred to as a
"[[Events#Shrine Events|Shrine Event]]" by the Community? |- |'''[[Events#Act Events|Act Event]]''' |Common |Yes |No |No |- |'''[[Events#Shrines|Shrine]]''' |Rare |No |Yes, after Act transition |Yes |- |'''[[Events#One-Time Events|One-Time Event]]''' |Rare |Varies |No |Yes |} === Act Events === Internally, these are simply called Events. Act events can be considered as the baseline "normal events". They can all only be encountered in a specific Act, and can each only be encountered once. For example, {{E|Big Fish}} is an event that is exclusive to Act 1. Once the player encounters it in Act 1 they will not see that event again for the remainder of Act 1 (and by extension, the rest of the run). If they do not see {{E|Big Fish}} during Act 1, they have missed their chance to encounter it and it is now impossible to see the event on that run. For a list of all Act Events, see the {{QueryLink|Events||Events List}} filtered to a particular Act ({{QueryLink|Events|act:1&shrine:No|Act 1 Events}} or {{QueryLink|Events|act:2&shrine:No|Act 2 Events}} or {{QueryLink|Events|act:3&shrine:No|Act 3 Events}}). === Shrines === Internally, these are still called Shrines. Not to be confused with ''"events that have Shrine in their name"'' (such as {{E|Golden Shrine}}), a ''Shrine'' is a specific event type all on its own. Shrines include what a player may consider to be a "shrine", but also a few events that "might not seem like shrines". For example, {{E|Golden Shrine}} and {{E|Transmogrifier}} are shrines, but so is {{E|Wheel of Change}}. Shrines can be encountered in any Act, and can only be encountered once per Act. Once the player transitions from one Act to the next, all of the Shrines can be encountered again. For example, if the player encounters {{E|Wheel of Change}} in Act 1, it's possible for them to see it again in Act 2 and/or Act 3. Shrines are rarer than [[#Act Events|Act Events]] due to how Slay the Spire determines what event to show the player. For more information, see [[#Encountering Events|Encountering Events]]. The {{QueryLink|Events||Events List}} is currently not capable of filtering for just this specific type of event; it can only filter for the unofficial [[#Shrine Events|Shrine Events]] type which combines Shrines with [[#One-Time Events|One-Time Events]]. In the meantime, the list of Shrines is provided below for convenience. * {{E|Golden Shrine}} * {{E|Match and Keep}} * {{E|Purifier}} * {{E|Transmogrifier}} * {{E|Upgrade Shrine}} * {{E|Wheel of Change}} === One-Time Events === Internally, these are called Special One Time Events. One-Time Events can only be encountered once per run. They can each have their own Act limitations, although most One-Time Events can be encountered in any Act. For example, {{E|Bonfire Spirits}} is a One-Time Event that can be encountered in any Act. If the player encounters this event in Act 1, they will never be able to encounter it again for the rest of the run even after they transition to Act 2 or Act 3. One-Time Events are rarer than [[#Act Events|Act Events]] due to how Slay the Spire determines what event to show the player. For more information, see [[#Encountering Events|Encountering Events]]. This increased rarity is also what separates the One-Time Events which can only be encountered in one specific Act (such as the Act 2-exclusive {{E|N'loth}}) from the normal [[#Act Events|Act Events]]. The {{QueryLink|Events||Events List}} is currently not capable of filtering for just this specific type of event; it can only filter for the unofficial [[#Shrine Events|Shrine Events]] type which combines [[#Shrines|Shrines]] with One-Time Events. In the meantime, the list of One-Time Events is provided below for convenience. Alternatively, use the {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|Events List filtered to Shrine Events}} and disregard any of the [[#Shrines|Shrines]]. * {{E|A Note For Yourself}} * {{E|Bonfire Spirits}} * {{E|Designer In-Spire}} (only Act 2 and Act 3) * {{E|Duplicator}} * {{E|Face Trader}} (only Act 1 and Act 2) * {{E|Knowing Skull}} (only Act 2) * {{E|Lab}} * {{E|N'loth}} (only Act 2) * {{E|Ominous Forge}} * {{E|Secret Portal}} (only Act 3) * {{E|The Divine Fountain}} * {{E|The Joust}} (only Act 2) * {{E|The Woman in Blue}} * {{E|We Meet Again!}} === Shrine Events === Internally, this is not an event type at all. The Slay the Spire community tends to use the term "Shrine Events" to refer to both [[#Shrines|Shrines]] and [[#One-Time Events|One-Time Events]] as if they are a single event type. In reality, Slay the Spire keeps track of Shrines and One-Time Events in separate pools. The term to combine them likely comes from the way that Slay the Spire decides which event to present the player, since when the game determines that a rare event should be encountered it combines the pools for Shrines and the One-Time Events together and then selects a random rare event from that combined pool. For more information, see [[#Encountering Events|Encountering Events]]. For a list of all Shrine Events, see the {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|Events List filtered to Shrine Events}}. == Bugs == * [[#Shrines|Shrines]] are meant to only be encountered at most once per Act. However, there is a bug that allows them to be encountered multiple times per Act. If the player saves and quits the run in the middle of an Act, the next time they continue the run all of the [[#Shrines|Shrines]] can be encountered again even if they have already been seen before the save and quit. This is because, unlike the [[#Act Events|Act Events]] and [[#One-Time Events|One-Time Events]], the [[#Shrines|Shrine]] pool is not saved and is instead always set as if none of them have been encountered whenever an existing run is loaded.
